**A {{M|w|6.1|link=y}} earthquake strikes western [[Turkey]], killing one person, injuring 35 others, trapping several and causing at least 16 buildings and two [[mosque]] [[minaret]]s to collapse in [[Balıkesir Province]] and [[Manisa]].
